# clean data
```{r}
parameterClassification_clean <- parameterClassification_raw |> 
  mutate(season = strsplit(season, ",\\s*")) |>  # Split multi-season entries into lists
  unnest(season) |>  # Expand into multiple rows
  group_by(author, parameter_name) |>  # Group by unique study
  mutate(All_Seasons_Flag = ifelse(all(c("summer", "autumn", "winter", "spring") %in% season), TRUE, FALSE)) |> 
  ungroup() |>  
  mutate(season = ifelse(All_Seasons_Flag, "All Seasons", season)) |>  # Replace with "All Seasons"
  select(-All_Seasons_Flag)  # Remove temporary column

# Broad Region	Included Locations
# Define location groups
parameterClassification_clean <- parameterClassification_clean |> 
  # Unnest location separated by ",", ";", " & ", and " and "
  mutate(location = strsplit(location, ",|;|\\s&|\\sand\\s")) |>  
  unnest(location) |>  # Expand into multiple rows
  
  # Trim whitespace to avoid incorrect matches
  mutate(location = str_trim(location)) |>  

  
   # Assign region based on keyword detection
  mutate(region = case_when(
    is.na(location) ~ "Circumpolar Studies",  # Explicitly set NA locations to Circumpolar Studies
    
    str_detect(location, regex("Scotia Sea|Scotia|Weddell Sea|Weddell|South Georgia|SouthGeorgia|Bouvet Island|Lazarev Sea|Antarctic Peninsula|South Shetland Islands|Weddel-Scotia Confluence|Deception Island|Drake Passage|Georgia|Admiralty Bay|Scotia-Weddell|Wilhelmina Bay|Elephant Island|South Sandwich Islands|Bismarck Strait|South Orkney Islands|Western Antarctic Peninsula|Marguerite Bay|Gerlache Strait|Atlantic sector|Southwest Atlantic|WAP", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Atlantic (including Antarctic Peninsula)",
    
    str_detect(location, regex("Prydz Bay|Indian Sector|Enderby Land|southern part of Indian Ocean|Western Indian Ocean|Indian Ocean", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Central Indian",
    
    str_detect(location, regex("East Antarctica|Wilkes Land|Lutzow-Holm Bay|Queen Maud Land", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "East Indian",
    
    str_detect(location, regex("Pacific Sector of the Southern Ocean|Bellingshausen Sea|Charlotte Bay and Bransfield Strait|Bellinghausen Sea|Bellingshausen|Eastern Bellinghausen Sea|Eastern Bellinghausen Sea (slope)|Elephant Island|Crystal Sound|Adelaide Island|South-West Atlantic|Bransfield Strait|Charlotte Bay", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "East Pacific",
    
    str_detect(location, regex("Ross Sea|Tasman Sea", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "West Pacific",
    
    str_detect(location, regex("Southern Ocean|Circumpolar|60°S", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Circumpolar Studies",
    
    TRUE ~ "Other"  # Only truly unknown locations will go into "Other"
  )) 

# pull out the "Other" region
other_region <- parameterClassification_clean |> 
  filter(region == "Other") |> 
  select(location) |> 
  unique()
print(other_region, n = "inf")

# Summarize the number of studies in each region
region_groups <- parameterClassification_clean |> 
  select(region, location, author, parameter_name) |>
  group_by(region) |> 
  summarise(count_location = n_distinct(location),
            count_parameter = n_distinct(parameter_name)) 
print(region_groups, n = "inf")

# break down the Atlantic
parameterClassification_clean <- parameterClassification_clean |> 
  mutate(
    location = str_trim(location),  # Ensure consistent formatting
    location_slim = case_when(
      region == "Atlantic (including Antarctic Peninsula)" & str_detect(location, regex("WAP|Antarctic Peninsula|Bismarck Strait|Marguerite Bay|Gerlache Strait|Marguerite Bay|Deception Island|Admiralty Bay|Wilhelmina Bay", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Western Antarctic Peninsula",
      region == "Atlantic (including Antarctic Peninsula)" & str_detect(location, regex("Georgia|South Georgia", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "South Georgia",
      region == "Atlantic (including Antarctic Peninsula)" & str_detect(location, regex("Weddell Sea|Weddell|Weddel-Scotia Confluence|Weddell-Scotia Confluence", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Weddell Sea",
      region == "Atlantic (including Antarctic Peninsula)" & str_detect(location, regex("South Shetland Islands|Elephant Island", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "South Shetland Islands",
      region == "Atlantic (including Antarctic Peninsula)" & str_detect(location, regex("South Orkney Islands", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "South Orkney Islands",
      region == "Atlantic (including Antarctic Peninsula)" & str_detect(location, regex("South Sandwich Islands", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "South Sandwich Islands",
      region == "Atlantic (including Antarctic Peninsula)" & str_detect(location, regex("Lazarev Sea", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Lazarev Sea",
      region == "Atlantic (including Antarctic Peninsula)" & str_detect(location, regex("Scotia Sea|Drake|Scotia-Weddell|Scotia", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Scotia Sea",
      region == "Atlantic (including Antarctic Peninsula)" & str_detect(location, regex("Bouvet Island|Atlantic sector|Southwest Atlantic", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Southwest Atlantic",
      TRUE ~ location  # Keep original values for non-Atlantic regions
    )
  )

# study type by region

  group_by(region, study_type, season) |> 
  summarise(n = n_distinct(parameter_name),.groups = "keep") |> 
  ungroup() |>
  #group_by(region, study_type) |> 
  mutate(tot = sum(n), 
            prop = round(n / tot*100))
print(study_type_region, n = "inf")
```

# Results: Part 1 - Scope and Selection of Studies
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

# Clean and extract study years while preserving other data
parameterClassification_clean <- parameterClassification_clean |> 
  #select(author, study_years, study_type, parameter_name, parameter_value) |> 
  # If parameter_name is NA, fill with parameter_value
  mutate(parameter_name = ifelse(is.na(parameter_name), parameter_value, parameter_name)) |> 
  # Replace NA study_years with "unknown" only for missing values
  mutate(study_years = ifelse(is.na(study_years), "unknown", study_years)) |> 
  # Extract first and last year, handling single-year studies
  mutate(Start_Year = ifelse(str_detect(study_years, "^\\d{4}$"), 
                             as.numeric(study_years), 
                             as.numeric(str_extract(study_years, "^\\d{4}"))),
         End_Year = as.numeric(str_extract(study_years, "\\d{4}$"))) %>%
  # If only one year exists, assume it is both Start and End
  mutate(End_Year = ifelse(is.na(End_Year), Start_Year, End_Year)) |> 
  # Keep only rows where both Start_Year and End_Year are valid
  mutate(Start_Year = ifelse(!is.na(Start_Year) & !is.na(End_Year) & Start_Year <= End_Year, Start_Year, NA),
         End_Year = ifelse(!is.na(Start_Year) & !is.na(End_Year) & Start_Year <= End_Year, End_Year, NA)) |> 
  # Drop rows where both parameter_value and parameter_name are NA
  filter(!is.na(parameter_name) | !is.na(parameter_value))

# Expand years for decade analysis, ensuring Start_Year and End_Year are retained
decades <- parameterClassification_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(Start_Year) & !is.na(End_Year)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(All_Years = list(seq(Start_Year, End_Year, by = 1))) %>%
  unnest(All_Years) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Assign decades for each year
  mutate(Decade = case_when(
    All_Years < 1960 ~ "Pre-1960",
    All_Years >= 1960 & All_Years <= 2020 ~ as.character(floor(All_Years / 10) * 10),
    All_Years > 2020 ~ "Post-2020"
  )) %>%
  # Convert Decade to an ordered factor
  mutate(Decade = factor(Decade, levels = c("Pre-1960", "1960", "1970", "1980", "1990", "2000", "2010", "Post-2020"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
  # Keep only relevant columns
  select(author, study_type, parameter_name, Start_Year, End_Year, All_Years, Decade)


# Summarize the number of studies and parameters per decade
study_decade_summary <- decades %>%
  group_by(Decade, study_type) %>%
  summarise(
    Study_Count = n_distinct(author),       # Number of unique studies
    Parameter_Count = n_distinct(parameter_name),  # Number of unique parameters
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sum(study_decade_summary$Study_Count)
sum(study_decade_summary$Parameter_Count)

# # Identify rows where Decade is NA (should now be empty)
# na_study_years <- study_years_slim %>%
#   filter(is.na(Decade))
# print(na_study_years)

# when did research start in the WAP compared to the other regions?
# Identify when research started in each region
region_start_years <- parameterClassification_clean %>%
  select(region, location_slim, Start_Year, parameterID, title) %>%  # Select relevant columns
  distinct() |> 
  filter(!is.na(Start_Year)) %>%  # Ensure only valid years are included
  group_by(region, location_slim) %>%
  summarise(Earliest_Research_Year = min(Start_Year, na.rm = TRUE),
            Latest_Research_Year = max(Start_Year, na.rm = TRUE),
            Study_Count = n()) %>%  # Count number of studies per region
  arrange(Earliest_Research_Year)  # Order by the first recorded study
print(region_start_years)

# Highlight when research began in the Western Antarctic Peninsula
WAP_start_year <- region_start_years %>% 
  filter(location_slim == "Western Antarctic Peninsula")
print(WAP_start_year)

# Prepare data (assuming parameterClassification_clean contains the data)
region_start_years <- parameterClassification_clean %>%
  select(region, Start_Year, End_Year, title, parameterID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(Start_Year)) %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(Earliest_Research_Year = min(Start_Year, na.rm = TRUE),
            Latest_Research_Year = max(End_Year, na.rm = TRUE),
            Study_Count = n()) %>%
  arrange(Earliest_Research_Year)
region_start_years

# Plot research start years per region
ggplot(region_start_years, aes(x = Earliest_Research_Year, y = Study_Count, color = region, group = region)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +  # Line for each region
  geom_point(size = 2) +  # Points to highlight start years
  labs(x = "Year of First Study", y = "Number of Studies",
       title = "Number of Studies per Region Over Time",
       color = "Region") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "right")
```

```{r decade_plot}
# Define full category levels for completeness
decade_levels <- c("Pre-1960", "1960", "1970", "1980", "1990", "2000", "2010")
study_type_levels <- c("observation", "model", "hybrid")

# Ensure Decade and Study Type have complete categories
study_decade_summary <- study_decade_summary %>%
  complete(study_type = factor(study_type_levels, levels = study_type_levels),
           Decade,
           fill = list(Study_Count = 0, Parameter_Count = 0)) |> 
  # filter out the post 2020
  filter(Decade != "Post-2020")
print(study_decade_summary, n = "inf")

  "Pre-1960" = "#d3d3d3",  # Light gray

  "1980s" = "#8da0cb",
```

```{r season_plot}
# Prepare the dataset
season_plot_data <- parameterClassification_clean |> 
  select(region, study_type, season, parameter_name) |> 
    # drop study_type == "review" and NA
    filter(study_type != "review" & !is.na(study_type)) |> 
  # rename season == NA as "undefined
  mutate(season = ifelse(is.na(season), "undefined", season)) |>
  group_by(season, study_type) |> 
  summarise(Count = n_distinct(parameter_name), .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(season = factor(season, levels = c("undefined", "summer", "autumn", "winter", "spring", "All Seasons"))) |> 
  complete(season, study_type, fill = list(Count = 0))

)
```

# Results: Part 2 - Parameter Classification
## parameter classification
```{r}
parameterClassification_slim <- parameterClassification_raw |> 
  #read_csv('~/github/ICEDPaper1/data/parameterClassifications20231109.csv') %>%
  mutate(parameterID = row_number()) %>%
  #select(parameterID, `modelSubUnit`, `informationCategory`) %>%
  mutate(mechanismID = str_split(`modelSubUnit`, pattern = ',')) %>%
  unnest(mechanismID) %>%
   distinct(parameterID, mechanismID, .keep_all = TRUE) |> # Remove duplicate parameter-mechanism assignments
  # add 'ID' to mechanismID if if doesnt have 'ID' , ignoring NA
  mutate(mechanismID = ifelse(!is.na(mechanismID) & !grepl("ID", mechanismID), paste0("ID", mechanismID), mechanismID)) %>%
  mutate(mechanismID = str_replace_all(mechanismID, " ", ""),
         mechanismID = ifelse(mechanismID == '-', NA, mechanismID)) |> 
  select(-`modelSubUnit`)

# bind additional info to parameter classification table
bind_parameterClassification <- parameterClassification_slim  %>% 
  left_join(., mechanismMeta, by = c('mechanismID' = 'modelSubUnit')) %>% 
  mutate(informationCategory = ifelse(informationCategory == '-' | 
                                        informationCategory == ' ',
                                      NA, informationCategory),
         informationCategory = ifelse(is.na(informationCategory), 'not assigned', informationCategory),
         informationCategory = factor(informationCategory, levels = c('correlation', 'parameter', 'validation','parameter, validation', 'not assigned')),
         submechanism = ifelse(is.na(submechanism), 'not assigned', 
                               ifelse(submechanism == 'egg_larval', 'egg and larval\n development', submechanism)),
         submechanism = factor(submechanism, levels = c('not assigned','mortality','overwintering','egg and larval\n development', 'spawning')))

# define parameter color classification
colourKey <- tibble(informationCategory = c('correlation', 'parameter', 'validation','parameter, validation', 'not assigned'),
                    label = informationCategory,
                    colour = c(scico(5, palette = 'vikO', begin = 0.2, end = 0.8, direction = -1)[5:2],'#5e5e5e'))

  mutate(colour = factor(colour, levels = c(scico(5, palette = 'vikO', begin = 0.2, end = 0.8, direction = -1)[5:2],'#5e5e5e')))
```

```{r}
binded_slim <- bind_parameterClassification |> 
  mutate(study_years = as.character(study_years)) %>%
  mutate(Start_Year = as.numeric(str_extract(study_years, "^\\d{4}")),
         End_Year = as.numeric(str_extract(study_years, "\\d{4}$"))) %>%
  mutate(End_Year = ifelse(is.na(End_Year), Start_Year, End_Year)) %>%
  # filter(!is.na(Start_Year) & !is.na(End_Year)) %>%
  # filter(Start_Year <= End_Year) %>%
  # rowwise() %>%
  # mutate(All_Years = list(seq(Start_Year, End_Year, by = 1))) %>%
  # unnest(All_Years) %>%
  # mutate(Decade = floor(All_Years / 10) * 10) %>%
  # 
  # # Categorize Pre-1960 and Post-2020 studies
  # mutate(Decade = case_when(
  #   Decade < 1960 ~ "Pre-1960",
  #   Decade >= 1960 & Decade <= 2020 ~ as.character(Decade),
  #   Decade > 2020 ~ "Post-2020"
  # )) %>%
  # 
  # # Convert Decade to an ordered factor
  # mutate(Decade = factor(Decade, levels = c("Pre-1960", "1960", "1970", "1980", "1990", "2000", "2010"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%

  # Remove unnecessary columns
  select(-parameter_value) |> 
  mutate(season = strsplit(season, ",\\s*")) |>  # Split multi-season entries into lists
  unnest(season) |>  # Expand into multiple rows
  group_by(author, parameter_name) |>  # Group by unique study
  mutate(All_Seasons_Flag = ifelse(all(c("summer", "autumn", "winter", "spring") %in% season), TRUE, FALSE)) |> 
  ungroup() |>  
  mutate(season = ifelse(All_Seasons_Flag, "All Seasons", season)) |>  # Replace with "All Seasons"
  select(-All_Seasons_Flag) |>  # Remove temporary column
  mutate(location = strsplit(location, ",|;|\\s&|\\sand\\s")) |>  
  unnest(location) |>  # Expand into multiple rows
  
  # Trim whitespace to avoid incorrect matches
  mutate(location = str_trim(location)) |>  

  
   # Assign region based on keyword detection
  mutate(region = case_when(
    is.na(location) ~ "Circumpolar Studies",  # Explicitly set NA locations to Circumpolar Studies
    
    str_detect(location, regex("Scotia Sea|Scotia|Weddell Sea|Weddell|South Georgia|SouthGeorgia|Bouvet Island|Lazarev Sea|Antarctic Peninsula|South Shetland Islands|Weddel-Scotia Confluence|Deception Island|Drake Passage|Georgia|Admiralty Bay|Scotia-Weddell|Wilhelmina Bay|Elephant Island|South Sandwich Islands|Bismarck Strait|South Orkney Islands|Western Antarctic Peninsula|Marguerite Bay|Gerlache Strait|Atlantic sector|Southwest Atlantic|WAP", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Atlantic (including Antarctic Peninsula)",
    
    str_detect(location, regex("Prydz Bay|Indian Sector|Enderby Land|southern part of Indian Ocean|Western Indian Ocean|Indian Ocean", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Central Indian",
    
    str_detect(location, regex("East Antarctica|Wilkes Land|Lutzow-Holm Bay|Queen Maud Land", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "East Indian",
    
    str_detect(location, regex("Pacific Sector of the Southern Ocean|Bellingshausen Sea|Charlotte Bay and Bransfield Strait|Bellinghausen Sea|Bellingshausen|Eastern Bellinghausen Sea|Eastern Bellinghausen Sea (slope)|Elephant Island|Crystal Sound|Adelaide Island|South-West Atlantic|Bransfield Strait|Charlotte Bay", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "East Pacific",
    
    str_detect(location, regex("Ross Sea|Tasman Sea", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "West Pacific",
    
    str_detect(location, regex("Southern Ocean|Circumpolar|60°S", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Circumpolar Studies",
    
    TRUE ~ "Other"  # Only truly unknown locations will go into "Other"
  )) |> 
  select(colour, submechanism, study_type, informationCategory, parameter_name, region, location, author, study_years, season, parameterID, mechanismID) 

n_submechanism <- binded_slim |> 
  group_by(study_type, submechanism, season) |>
  summarize(count = n(), .groups = "keep") |>
  ungroup()
print(n_submechanism, n = "inf")

binded_slim |>

    season = ifelse(is.na(season), "undefined", season),

  # Adjust label placement within bars
```

```{r}
  # clean up life stage
  
# Function to clean and standardize life stage names
# Function to clean life stage categories
clean_lifestage <- function(lifestage) {
  if (is.na(lifestage)) {
    return("unknown")
  }
  
  lifestage <- tolower(str_trim(lifestage))  # Convert to lowercase and trim spaces
  
  # Direct classifications
  if (lifestage %in% c("egg", "juvenile", "larvae", "adult")) {
    return(lifestage)
  } 
  # Merge nauplius and metanauplius into larvae
  else if (str_detect(lifestage, "nauplius")) {
    return("larvae")  
  } 
  # Merge furcilia into larvae
  else if (str_detect(lifestage, "furcilia")) {
    return("larvae")  
  } 
  else if (str_detect(lifestage, "nauplius to metanauplius")) {
    return("larvae")  
  }
  # Handle mixed categories
  else if (str_detect(lifestage, "larvae") & str_detect(lifestage, "juvenile")) {
    return("larvae, juvenile")  
  } 
  else if (str_detect(lifestage, "egg") & str_detect(lifestage, "adult")) {
    return("egg to adult")
  } 
  else if (str_detect(lifestage, "larvae")) {
    return("larvae")
  } 
  else if (str_detect(lifestage, "juvenile")) {
    return("juvenile")
  } 
  else if (str_detect(lifestage, "adult")) {
    return("adult")
  }
  
  return("other")
}

# Function to classify parameter origin
classify_origin <- function(origin) {
  if (is.na(origin)) {
    return("unknown")
  }
  
  origin <- tolower(str_trim(origin))  # Convert to lowercase and remove whitespace
  
  # Laboratory-based methods
  lab_keywords <- c("laboratory", "experiment", "incubation", "observations", "measurement", "growth")
  if (any(str_detect(origin, lab_keywords))) {
    return("Laboratory")
  }
  
  # Field-based methods
  field_keywords <- c("net", "field", "observation", "caught", "sampling", "video plankton recorder")
  if (any(str_detect(origin, field_keywords))) {
    return("Field")
  }
  
  model_keywords <- c("mechanistic model")
  if (any(str_detect(origin, model_keywords))) {
    return("Mechanistic model")
  }
  
  # Statistical or derived methods
  statistical_keywords <- c("regression", "anova", "correlation", "pca", "glm", "stokes", "equation", "decay", "empirical", "model", "statistical", "analysis", "biochemical")
  if (any(str_detect(origin, statistical_keywords))) {
    return("Statistical Model")
  }
  
  return("Other")
}

# Apply function to clean lifestage column
egg_larval_data <- egg_descrip %>%
  mutate(cleaned_lifestage = sapply(parameter_lifestage, clean_lifestage)) |> 
  mutate(cleaned_origin = sapply(parameter_origin, classify_origin)) |> 
  separate_rows(cleaned_lifestage, sep = ", ")
```

```{r}
# Function to classify parameter origin
classify_origin <- function(origin) {
  if (is.na(origin)) {
    return("unknown")
  }
  
  origin <- tolower(str_trim(origin))  # Convert to lowercase and remove whitespace
  
  # Laboratory-based methods
  lab_keywords <- c("laboratory", "experiment", "incubation", "observations", "measurement", "growth")
  if (any(str_detect(origin, lab_keywords))) {
    return("Laboratory")
  }
  
  # Field-based methods
  field_keywords <- c("net", "field", "observation", "caught", "sampling", "video plankton recorder")
  if (any(str_detect(origin, field_keywords))) {
    return("Field")
  }
  
  model_keywords <- c("mechanistic model")
  if (any(str_detect(origin, model_keywords))) {
    return("Mechanistic model")
  }
  
  # Statistical or derived methods
  statistical_keywords <- c("regression", "anova", "correlation", "pca", "glm", "stokes", "equation", "decay", "empirical", "model", "statistical", "analysis", "biochemical")
  if (any(str_detect(origin, statistical_keywords))) {
    return("Statistical Model")
  }
  
  return("Other")
}
```

# MORTALITY
## PLOT
```{r}
mortality <- bind_parameterClassification %>% 
  left_join(., mechanismMeta) %>%
  filter(submechanism == 'mortality') %>%   
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(stage = tail(unlist(str_split(enviro_vars, '_')), n = 1),
         stage = factor(stage, levels = c('larvae','embryo','adults')),
         enviro_vars = paste(head(unlist(str_split(enviro_vars, '_')), -1), collapse = '_'),
         enviro_vars = ifelse(grepl('other_mortality', enviro_vars), "other mortality", enviro_vars),
         mortFactor = ifelse(enviro_vars %in% c("parasitism", "predation", "starvation", "temperature", "fisheries"),
                             enviro_vars,
                             "other mortality")) %>% 
  ungroup() |> 
  #select(-submechanism, -parameterID, -classifier, -mechanismID, -type, -name, -enviro_vars, -label) |> 
  group_by(stage, mortFactor, informationCategory) |> 
  mutate(count = n()) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  distinct() |> 
  group_by(stage, mortFactor) |> 
  mutate(tot = sum(count)) |> 
  # Update tot values for specific stages
  mutate(tot = case_when(
    stage == "larvae" ~ 65,
    stage == "adult" ~ 48,
    stage == "embryo" ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ tot
  )) |> 
  # Update count values based on visible proportions in the plot for larvae and adult
  mutate(count = case_when(
    # Larvae counts broken down by proportion
    stage == "larvae" & mortFactor == "starvation" & informationCategory == "parameter, validation" ~ round(24 * 0.23),
    stage == "larvae" & mortFactor == "starvation" & informationCategory == "correlation" ~ round(24 * 0.06),
    stage == "larvae" & mortFactor == "other mortality" & informationCategory == "parameter, validation" ~ round(30 * 0.22),
    stage == "larvae" & mortFactor == "other mortality" & informationCategory == "correlation" ~ round(30 * 0.14),
    stage == "larvae" & mortFactor == "temperature" & informationCategory == "parameter, validation" ~ round(4 * 0.05),
    stage == "larvae" & mortFactor == "temperature" & informationCategory == "correlation" ~ round(4 * 0.02),
    stage == "larvae" & mortFactor == "predation" & informationCategory == "parameter, validation" ~ round(5 * 0.05),
    stage == "larvae" & mortFactor == "parasitism" & informationCategory == "parameter, validation" ~ round(2 * 0.02),
    
    # Adult counts broken down by proportion
    stage == "adult" & mortFactor == "starvation" & informationCategory == "parameter, validation" ~ round(40 * 0.64),
    stage == "adult" & mortFactor == "starvation" & informationCategory == "correlation" ~ round(40 * 0.07),
    stage == "adult" & mortFactor == "other mortality" & informationCategory == "parameter, validation" ~ round(8 * 0.07),
    stage == "adult" & mortFactor == "other mortality" & informationCategory == "correlation" ~ round(8 * 0.07),
    
    # If not specified, retain the original count
    TRUE ~ count)) |> 
  # Recalculate proportion based on updated counts
  mutate(proportion = (count / tot) * 100) |> 
  ungroup()

  
  # Complete the dataset
mortality <- mortality |>  
  complete(stage, mortFactor = c("parasitism", "predation", "starvation", "temperature", "fisheries", "other mortality"),
           informationCategory, colour, fill = list(tot = 0, count = 0, proportion = 0)) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  mutate(mortFactor = ifelse(is.na(mortFactor), "other mortality", mortFactor),
         stage = factor(stage, levels = c('embryo', 'larvae', 'adults')),
         mortFactor = factor(mortFactor, levels = c("other mortality", "temperature", "starvation", "predation",
                                                    "parasitism", "fisheries")))
```
